summary: Master NGO talent acquisition and retention. Learn CHS standards, Duty of Care, and data-driven recruitment to build resilient humanitarian teams.
lede: Talent Acquisition and Retention in NGOs helps you recruit specialized professionals, strengthen mission alignment, and sustain staff engagement in high-pressure humanitarian and development settings. You will learn to apply practical selection tools, support staff wellbeing through the IASC Guidelines on Mental Health and Psychosocial Support, and use AI-driven candidate screening for high-volume responses. Build a structured talent system around competency frameworks, behavioral assessments, talent pipelines, Duty of Care audits, turnover-cost calculations, and people analytics reporting. The course also equips you to design total rewards that balance financial constraints with intrinsic motivation and create a sustainable pipeline through the transition from emergency response to long-term development programming.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is essential for professionals responsible for the human capital lifecycle within non-governmental and intergovernmental organizations.
audience: Talent Acquisition Specialists focused on humanitarian field
modules: Foundations of Strategic NGO Talent Management
Metrics and Analytics in NGO Recruitment
Developing a Compelling NGO Employee Value Proposition
Sourcing Strategies and AI in Talent Acquisition
Duty of Care and Staff Wellbeing
Localization and Diversity in Talent Acquisition
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in HR, recruitment, or program management within the NGO or public sector. Familiarity with basic recruitment processes and organizational structures is required. Pre-reading on the Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) is recommended.
